etims_items_scope_branch_chk.name: etims_items_scope_branch_chk
etims_items_scope_branch_chk.value: ("etims_items"."config_source" = 'company' and "etims_items"."branch_id" is null) or ("etims_items"."config_source" = 'branch' and "etims_items"."branch_id" is not null)

media_assets_location_chk.name: media_assets_location_chk
media_assets_location_chk.value: ("media_assets"."provider" = 'external' and "media_assets"."source_url" is not null) or ("media_assets"."provider" <> 'external' and "media_assets"."storage_key" is not null)

number_series_alloc_document_uidx.name: number_series_alloc_document_uidx
number_series_alloc_document_uidx.where: "number_series_allocations"."document_kind" is not null and "number_series_allocations"."document_id" is not null
